definitions: someone connected with any number of soccer clubs known as the Wanderers.

blocks.text: The Wanderer is a 1913 American silent drama film short film directed by D. W. Griffith and produced by the Biograph Company. Prints of the film exist in private collections.
The Wanderer is a 1925 American silent drama film directed by Raoul Walsh and starring Greta Nissen, Wallace Beery, and Tyrone Power Sr. It was distributed by Paramount Pictures.

The Wanderer is a character from the video game Genshin Impact, developed by miHoYo. He first appeared in Version 1.1 of the game in 2020 and became a playable character in Version 3.3 in 2022, along with a boss version of him. He is an artificial lifeform created by Raiden Ei, the fictional ruler of the nation of Inazuma. He named himself Kunikuzushi, later joined the antagonist organization the Fatui, and was further named Scaramouche and codenamed The Balladeer. In the boss fight, he is given the title Everlasting Lord of Arcane Wisdom. He appears as a villain during the Inazuma arc of the game's storyline, but reforms during the subsequent arc set in Sumeru and becomes a ward of the Dendro Archon, Nahida.
